text:
monitoring-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT — p99 latency spike for Verity Finance (tenant vf-432) in eu-north dedicated pool dp-vf-eun-01. p99 = 18.3s, SLO = 6s. Errors up 4.2%
incident-bot: PagerDuty: triggered P1 for incident INC-2026-6112345678, paging @eric (on-call)
eric (on-call): I'm paging in SRE and eng, joining bridge now. URL: https://meet.redwood/bridges/6112345678 :phone:
mohit (sre): looking at pool metrics — CPU contended across 6 GPUs, high KV-cache miss rate. Possible tenant hot-path.
danielle (support): Verity support on call, reporting slow responses from embeddings endpoint and occasional 504s. CSM wants ETA for mitigation.
lina (acct): I'll open a customer-facing note and tell them we're investigating, will follow up with ETA in 10m.
audrey (eng): quick question — is this traffic spike all from vf-432 or multiple tenants? mohit, can you confirm top-talkers?
mohit (sre): top 3 tenants by reqs last 5m: vf-432 (62%), vf-legacy-71 (8%), internal-tests (3%). vf-432 is dominant.
eric (on-call): plan: 1) isolate tenant vf-432 to its own GPU slice if possible 2) failover some traffic to hosted fallback model 3) scale dp-vf-eun-01 if capacity permits. Assign roles?
audrey (eng): I'll own tenant isolation + fallback routing. mohit, you own pool scaling and KV cache checks. danielle handle customer comms.
mohit (sre): running quick health queries — cache eviction rate spiking. Suspect large prompt batch patterns causing KV blowup.
mohit (sre): command to isolate tenant (internal tool):
```
redwoodctl tenant isolate --tenant vf-432 --pool dp-vf-eun-01 --slice temporary-tenant-slice-09
```
mohit (sre): issuing now.
monitoring-bot: Action taken: tenant slice creation started (slice id tslice-09). Estimated completion 90s.
audrey (eng): while slice is building, I'll enable fallback routing for 20% of vf-432 requests to hosted small model to shed load:
```
redwoodctl routing update --tenant vf-432 --route-weight hosted-small=20,dp=80 --reason "mitigation: p99 spike"
```
audrey (eng): applied. will monitor.
monitoring-bot: vf-432 p99 dropped to 10.7s after routing change. still above SLO but improving.
eric (on-call): mohit, do we have room to scale dp-vf-eun-01 by +2 GPUs without violating capacity elsewhere?
mohit (sre): ephemeral capacity available in eu-north: +2 A100s (warm). Initiating scale (30s to attach).
monitoring-bot: Scale event started: adding 2 gpus to dp-vf-eun-01 (task id scale-611234).
danielle (support): CSM sent initial note to Verity: "Experiencing increased latency on eu-north dedicated pool — mitigation steps in progress. Next update in 10m."
lina (acct): customer appreciates the rapid updates, asking for risk of elevated costs — will update after stable.
mohit (sre): KV cache miss ratio trending down post-isolation, eviction rate normalized. p99 now 5.8s (within SLO).
eric (on-call): great — keep routing weight at 80/20 until scale fully active and we confirm stable for 10m. audrey, can you hold rollback plan ready?
audrey (eng): rollback plan: revert routing to 100% dp and remove tenant slice if stable. Command:
```
redwoodctl routing update --tenant vf-432 --route-weight dp=100 --reason "rollback after mitigation"
redwoodctl tenant remove-slice --slice tslice-09 --force
```
audrey (eng): noted.
monitoring-bot: Scale complete. GPUs attached. Pool throughput increased 38%. p99 steady at 4.9s.
eric (on-call): moving to recovery mode. danielle, send a follow-up to Verity: update with actions taken and ETA for full close.
danielle (support): sent to Verity: "We've isolated heavy traffic to a temporary slice, routed 20% of requests to a hosted fallback, and added capacity. p99 back within SLO. We'll monitor for 1 hour and follow up with RCA."
lina (acct): customer asks for RCA and whether they should change client behavior — offer to share prompt batching best practices and batching limits.
audrey (eng): agree. RCA items: 1) tenant-level burst pattern with large prompts 2) KV cache thrash due to atypical request shapes 3) lack of burst autoscale policy for dedicated-tenant slices.
mohit (sre): remediation actions: tighten tenant autoscale policy, set per-tenant KV cache caps, add early-warning anomaly on prefix traffic concentration.
eric (on-call): create incident ticket in tracker and assign RCA owners. Tagging follow-ups: #postmortem, #customer-communication.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-6112345678 set to RESOLVED state by eric (on-call) — monitoring will continue for 60m.
eric (on-call): thanks team — great coordination. postmortem POC audrey (eng) and mohit (sre). danielle to lead customer recap.
danielle (support): will draft customer note and share in #incidents-update before sending.
monitoring-bot: Final summary: duration 18m, peak p99 18.3s, mitigation: tenant isolation + routing + +2 GPUs, result p99 < 6s.
